reddit.title: Improved Music Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the music system in Provincia! No more hard cuts between day, night, title, and combat beds. Our new long equal-power self-crossfade ensures a seamless audio experience, enhancing your gameplay. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
